description: Four polyphonic attenuverters, each with an offset knob, so a signal can be scaled, inverted and shifted, or the section used as a bare voltage source

params.text: Scales that section's input, times one fully clockwise, zero in the middle and times minus one fully counter-clockwise, which inverts it; it comes up at zero
Adds a constant to that section's signal, -10V to +10V; with the ATTEN. knob at zero this is all the section puts out
Switches smart input normalling off and on; the panel prints I.N and it comes up on, in the upper position

inputs.text: That section's signal; its channel count sets how many channels the section works on, and with smart normalling on an unpatched section takes the signal from the last patched section above it

outputs.text: That section's signal after the ATTEN. and OFFSET knobs, clipped to ±10V

notes: The attenuverter knobs come up at zero, so a freshly placed Kitsune passes nothing until they are turned or the offsets are used.
A Denki expander placed immediately to the right adds a gain CV and an offset CV input for each of the four sections.
The small light at the top left of each input shows where that section's signal comes from: sections sharing a source share a colour, and the lights go dark when normalling is off.
menu: Input normalling: Off, Smart — the same choice the I.N switch makes
Add Denki expander — puts a Denki expander immediately to the right of this module and connects it; the entry reads "Denki expander already connected" when one is already there
